name: TUS ENVIRONMENTAL SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY DEVELOPMENT Co., Ltd.
summary: TUS Environmental Science and Technology Development Co., Ltd. offers a broad spectrum of environmental services and integrated solutions across the People's Republic of China. Their comprehensive offerings include waste management and utilization, ecological restoration, harnessing biomass resources, recycling and repurposing renewable materials, digital environmental sanitation services, and water resource administration. In addition to these services, the company manufactures specialized sanitation vehicles such as high-pressure street washers, kitchen garbage trucks, detachable container refuse vehicles, dust suppression trucks, pavement maintenance trucks, sweeping machines, street sweepers, compression garbage trucks, and self-handling waste vehicles. The firm, previously named Tus-Sound Environmental Resources Co., Ltd., was founded in 1993 and maintains its headquarters in Beijing, China.
